foundation.name: Synthetic Shift Note

problem.value: The next shift may not know the next action after a machine stoppage

trigger.value: A machine stops near a shift change

desiredOutcome.value: The next supervisor can understand what to do without a separate explanation

constraints: Synthetic examples; no messaging, deployment or spend
unknowns: Whether supervisors actually lose next-action context
Current workaround and buyer are unknown

proposal.title: Turn one machine-stoppage note into a clear next-shift handoff.
proposal.journey: Supervisor enters one stoppage note and reads a clear next action.
proposal.criticalUnknown: Can a supervisor act on a short handoff without the author explaining it?
proposal.why: A local example can expose unclear wording before building integrations; demand is still unknown.
proposal.nextAction: After approval, build a local text formatter using one synthetic note.
capabilities: Validate machine, problem and next action
technicalAcceptance: A complete note renders its machine, problem and next action
learningAcceptance: Later, a relevant supervisor can explain the next action without coaching; difficulty is a valid negative result
proposal.observationWindow: Review after one supervised demonstration; no customer exposure has occurred
